title: agents-cli agents.yaml
description: agents-cli metadata file. Two tiers share this shape: the central (synced) ~/.agents/agents.yaml and each per-device ~/.agents/devices/<host>/agents.yaml. Device-local fields (agents, isolatedAgents, defaultBrowserProfile, routines, device-scope config) belong in the device doc; everything else is portable user config. Source of truth: apps/cli/src/lib/types.ts (Meta).

agents.description: Per-device global version pins (agent id → version). Device doc only.

isolatedAgents.description: Per-device preferred isolated version per agent. Device doc only.

defaultBrowserProfile.description: Browser profile `agents browser start` resolves to without --profile. Device doc only (config key: browser.profile).

routines.description: Enabled routine names on this device. Membership means enabled; device doc only.

config.description: Typed config keys (registry: apps/cli/src/lib/device-config.ts). In the central file this holds user-scope keys (interactiveHost); in a device doc it holds device-scope keys (maxAgents, schedulerEnabled, notes). Unset keys keep default behavior.

interactiveHost.description: User scope. Device that shows the user artifacts (browser opens, dashboards). Set via `agents devices set-interactive`.

maxAgents.description: Device scope. Cap on concurrent agents (agents.max-concurrent). Factory auto-launch counts device-wide running agents; teams placement counts the team's roster on the device.

schedulerEnabled.description: Device scope. Whether the routines scheduler may fire here (scheduler.enabled).

notes.description: Device scope. Free-form operator notes (`agents devices note`).

secrets.description: macOS secrets-agent defaults (backend, prompt policy, hold window).

budget.description: Spend guardrails (user-global caps; project agents.yaml overrides).

registries.description: Resource registries by type (commands, skills, hooks, mcp, …).

profiles.description: Top-level resource profiles filtering the resolved resource set.

versions.description: Per-version resource tracking. Machine-local — partitioned to ~/.agents/.history/version-resources.json on write.

source.description: Git remote source URL of the system repo.

actors.description: Actors keyed by slug — who is behind a run.

seededPresets.description: Removal tombstones for seeded registry presets.

hooks.description: Hook manifest entries keyed by hook name.

browser.description: Browser profile definitions keyed by profile name (portable; syncs).

hosts.description: Agent-host registry (`agents hosts`) keyed by host name.

fleet.description: Declarative fleet profile (`agents apply`). Shape: lib/fleet/types.ts FleetManifest.

notify.description: Owner/channel notification config for `agents send` / `agents notify`.

projects.description: Allowlist of project roots whose .agents/routines may fire.
